newsitem.title: UK: Copper slightly up during LME evening trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper slightly up during LME evening trade.

text.p: Copper prices held just above the closing kerb levels during late Thursday inter-office trading.
By 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,270/72 a tonne against the kerb close at $2,2260, which was $4 up from Wednesday's finish.
Aluminium ws quoted at $1,550/52, unchanged from the kerb finish.
Broker Rudolf Wolff said in an evening report while further tests of underlying support were not ruled out, copper's downside potential was becoming limited. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
